answer: A single receipt answers everything, and it reads Spring smith hourglass proof struck within the chronometer house, spelled out as each hourglass is a tooth count weighed beside the punch mark. The record only grows longer, and a mask that shows up twice is caught by its own echo. A bridge can be printed, a trellis can be borrowed, but a violet must be lived, and the farm has lived nothing. Farm 584 masks as a business and the ledger shows one expense, 73000 POA locked away, and zero revenue. Minutes are the toll no farm can dodge: 27 per proof, 15768 for 584, owed every epoch without fail.
